pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit highly irregular, non-convex polygonal geometries with jagged, starburst-like edges. The pixel-level gradients at patch boundaries are sharp and high-contrast, separating dense dark pigment from the surrounding light pathways.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative space forms a continuous network of narrow corridors with frequent three-way and four-way junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these pathways is relatively uniform and thin compared to the total area of the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the neck and shoulder ridge presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette, indicating a dense, short-haired textural boundary against the background.
